description: Machine-readable OSS HTTP surface for drift checks. Keep in sync with packages/worker-core and docs/REPO-SPEC-OSS.md.

cors.description: Credentialed CORS (allow-credentials) for browser routes; allowlist derived from site config domain + trustedDomains. /consent.js is served with a public wildcard origin (no credentials).

portalDataSources.description: P3 observability: these portal GET endpoints are COMPUTED from data recorded on real traffic — never from operator-seeded KV JSON. The route-contract check enforces that /dashboard stays computed (portal.ts must call computeDashboardMetrics and must not read a seeded dashboard key).

computed./dashboard: eventsToday from the sampled per-UTC-day counter (attestrack:obs:events:*), drift alert count/detail from attestrack:drift:mismatch, strategy status from per-strategy delivery stats (attestrack:obs:delivery:*)
computed./destinations: per-strategy delivery stats + Worker secret presence; configured-but-quiet endpoints report status no_data
computed./logs: bounded per-hour KV log ring (attestrack:obs:log:*, 60 entries/hour, 48h TTL) written on /t/event ingest
computed./signal: de-scoped v1 (P3.3): { measured: false, reason: 'requires_beacon', botRequestsFiltered } — the bot counter (attestrack:obs:bots:*) is the only real figure
computed./signal-recovery/timeline: always [] in v1 (requires a client beacon; never invented points)

kvBacked./alert-rules: operator-defined rules from attestrack:portal:alert_rules, prepended with a synthetic consent-config row while attestrack:drift:mismatch is active

portalSubpathsRequiresAttestrue.description: Returned 403 JSON { error: requires_attestrue, handoff } — implemented in Attestrue worker-extension + licensed portal after upgrade.
